components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Main inspection action with an orange lower rule.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--color-shell); color: var(--color-paper); border: 1px solid var(--color-shell); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--color-safety); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-inspection), color 160ms var(--ease-inspection), border-color 160ms var(--ease-inspection); } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-safety); border-color: var(--color-safety); border-bottom-color: var(--color-safety-deep); color: var(--color-night); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-safety); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: var(--color-ink-faint); background: var(--color-shell-raised); border-color: var(--color-rule-strong); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Outlined supporting action for record controls.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 600; transition: border-color 140ms var(--ease-inspection), background-color 140ms var(--ease-inspection); } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-shell-raised); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-safety); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Package Field
components.description: Square monospace field for package names and exact versions.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-package">Package name</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-package" value="lodash" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; background: var(--color-sheet); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.4; transition: border-color 140ms var(--ease-inspection), background-color 140ms var(--ease-inspection); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-safety); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-oxide); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Compact uppercase navigation with an orange active-page rule.
components.html: ScanCompare
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.5rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--color-ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 140ms var(--ease-inspection), border-color 140ms var(--ease-inspection); } .ds-nav-link:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--color-shell-line); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-safety); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link-active { border-bottom-color: var(--color-safety); color: var(--color-paper); }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Square status label with explicit text and outlined signal color.
components.css: .ds-status-tag { display: inline-flex; min-height: 1.5rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-inspection-deep); color: var(--color-inspection-deep); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-tag-demo { border-color: var(--color-amber); background: var(--color-amber); color: var(--color-night); }

components.name: Record Sheet
components.description: Flat slate record surface separated by strong rules.
components.css: .ds-record-sheet { padding: 1rem; background: var(--color-sheet); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-top: 3px solid var(--color-shell); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-record-sheet h2 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-record-sheet p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Condition Stamp
components.description: Written condition and icon framed as an instrument stamp.
components.css: .ds-condition-stamp { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.15rem; padding: 0.55rem 1rem 0.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-safety-deep); color: var(--color-safety-deep); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-1.25deg); } .ds-condition-stamp small { font-size: 0.5rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; opacity: 0.85; }

narrative.overview:
DepScope is a working inspection desk for package condition records. A quiet blue-black shell and restrained instrument details keep attention on the report: its condition, confirmed evidence, heuristic signals, successful checks, and coverage gaps. The interface treats the condition stamp as an index into the evidence, never as a substitute for it.

The visual language is technical and legible: Overpass for interface text, Overpass Mono for labels and package data, square outlined sheets, fine rules, and sparse safety-orange markers. The desktop and mobile views retain the same evidence order; narrow layouts stack their panels and keep comparison overflow inside the table.
keyCharacteristics: Strong separation between findings, heuristics, and missing coverage.
Square, ruled surfaces with restrained orange, amber, and green signals.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written status or evidence label; it never carries severity, status, finding kind, or demo mode by itself.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep package identifiers and measured values in monospace; keep explanations in the interface sans serif.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Keep sheets flat and square; use tonal layering and rules to distinguish structure.

dos: Do keep the condition, findings, path, checks, sources, and limitations visibly distinct.
Do keep status and finding labels readable without color and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do use orange sparingly for inspection actions, focus, and confirmed-risk emphasis; reserve amber for caution and demo labeling.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences and keep narrow-screen tables in local scroll containers.
donts: Don't imply that missing or failed checks indicate a clean condition.
Don't blur confirmed advisories and heuristic signals into one category.
Don't add rounded dashboard cards, gradients, or glow effects to the flat inspection surfaces.
Don't present demo fixtures as live scan results.
